changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetResult') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetResult] ( Uid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, EffectiveDate datetime NOT NULL, RunDate datetime NOT NULL, PassCount bigint NOT NULL, FailCount bigint NOT NULL, TotalCount as (PassCount+FailCount) persisted, PassFraction as (PassCount / (PassCount+FailCount)) persisted, CreatedOn datetime NOT NULL, CreatedBy int NOT NULL, UpdatedOn datetime NOT NULL, UpdatedBy int NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_AssetResult PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( Uid ASC ) ) AS NODE END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: alter table dbo.AssetResult drop column PassFraction; alter table dbo.AssetResult add PassFraction as (cast(PassCount as float)/coalesce(cast(PassCount as float)+cast(FailCount as float),1)) persisted;
changeSet.rollback: alter table dbo.AssetResult drop column PassFraction; alter table dbo.AssetResult add PassFraction as (PassCount / (PassCount+FailCount)) persisted;

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: alter table dbo.AssetResult drop column PassFraction; alter table dbo.AssetResult add PassFraction as (CASE WHEN PassCount =0 and FailCount=0 THEN null ELSE (cast(PassCount as float)/coalesce(cast(PassCount as float)+cast(FailCount as float),1)) END) persisted;
changeSet.rollback: alter table dbo.AssetResult drop column PassFraction; alter table dbo.AssetResult add PassFraction as (cast(PassCount as float)/coalesce(cast(PassCount as float)+cast(FailCount as float),1)) persisted;
